About

A hands-on marketer, mid-campaign

I'm a hands-on marketer who enjoys turning ideas into campaigns people actually notice. My experience spans social media, content creation, campaign development, print collateral, events, and community marketing.

I've worked on everything from short-form video and branded content to grand openings, seasonal campaigns, flyers, interviews, and promotional experiences — combining strategy, creativity, and audience insight to bring a brand to life.
